reviews.rationale: Doorway-shadow watching is a human action, not architecture alone. N1_THRESHOLD realizes the woman pressed near the doorway watching its corridor from shadow; it moves the photograph from paper retention to guarded threshold attention. The final DIRECT15 keeps the more intimate paper-to-tray pause.

The complete coach/group/bags/checklist/leader-at-open-door scene is an excursion proxy, not a palace chamber. Its added group, vehicle and school-life context would replace the court moment at creativity1; no source terms are borrowed as generic waiting evidence.

The entire low-table/royal-side-chamber source is already realized by the literal baseline phrase low divan beside an inlaid walnut writing table within the palace chamber. No distinct extra change is needed; DIRECT15 retains it from the independent baseline rather than claiming material adoption.

The full source requires two crowned adults on opposite sides of one empty throne, including the second held crown. It encodes a different proxy event rather than the paused petition transfer; royal legitimacy, hostility and kinship remain unproven. Such a subject/event reconstruction is not a local creativity1 contribution here.

N1_THRESHOLD realizes all card/attendant-inside/visitor-outside/partly-open-door endpoints together. It makes access control more explicit but replaces the quieter table pause with gatekeeping; DIRECT15 retains the paper-and-tray relationship. No class exclusion, membership right or legal authority is inferred.

N4_TEA realizes all four bundle components: lowering endpoint of handled cup to matching saucer, fingers on handle with other hand clear, and small table between upholstered seats. It offers a tactile service action but replaces the petition with a second scenario; DIRECT15 keeps the more distinctive unfinished transfer. No coffee-wide custom inferred.

Open bus-door boarding includes passenger orientation, curb/stop path and retained bag ownership. That complete transport event is outside this intimate palace realization; a doorway word alone does not make it usable.

The complete portable-ledger/sealed-chest/folded-textile inner-court inventory explicitly requires Ming-Qing inner-court primary context. The frozen independent direction is Ottoman-inspired fiction and supplies no such context. Unmet source prerequisite; no partial inventory adopted.

Hermes ownership framing requires the represented Hermes, separate kerykeion staff and wings attached to his worn sandals. The messenger is not Hermes; none of those iconographic owners exist. Unmet declared primary-context requirement; generic messenger overlap is insufficient.

N2_LISTENING realizes lowered nonwriting pen, listener-to-speaker orientation, one shared document anchor and separate hand roles. It supports measured listening, but changes the cause of the pause to a close spoken exchange; the final preserves a visual unfinished transfer rather than claiming understanding of speech.

N3_SHARED_LINE realizes support of one document, fingertip at one marked region and the partner gaze following that same region. It is a coherent court joint-review alternative but shifts attention to a small line/annotation and brings the messenger beside the woman. DIRECT15 keeps the larger gap-based handover legibility.

N4_TEA realizes a visible serving role reversal from a lower camera position. It gives hospitality more importance and de-emphasizes the equal-height facial encounter; the final eye-level handover better preserves the selected quiet presence at creativity1.
The complete seated-support source already exists in she sits upright on a low divan. The final retains that independent posture and does not need an artificial new pose to use material.

Hands-and-regalia framing requires the actual regalia as well as hands. The independent scene specifies a petition and robe, without requester-owned crown or insignia; adding rank-marking objects only for this frame would distract from the textile test. It is not satisfied by hands alone.

N5_COUNTERGAZE realizes head toward window and irises toward messenger in one face, with modest angular difference. This adds a double visual direction and may weaken simple target attention; DIRECT15 retains the simpler messenger-directed look.

N3_SHARED_LINE realizes a supported open book, one source line, anchored annotation and separate page/pen hand roles. It makes scholarly work explicit but replaces the folded-petition gap story with reading. DIRECT15 preserves the large readable unfinished transfer.

The envelope source includes claim-investigation photographs inside an envelope. The independent folded petition has neither photographs nor investigation context; using only envelope/document resemblance would drop source meaning. Not adopted.

The contextual hair-handling source requires an established adult subject and all outside-scope actors/objects/context. The core does not witness adult age, and appearance hair.style effects risk the protected reference hair. No native adoption permission exists; no inferential age or desire claim added.

The declared Indigenous Futurisms repository access-level scene is absent. Its primary-context prerequisite cannot be supplied by a generic court document, and its language/intergenerational-knowledge relationships are not invented.
Underwater quadrat inspection requires marine/ecology/quadrat primary context and underwater capture. The current visible-light palace scene lacks it; no capture facet retained.
The ecological survey frame requires an environment/animal/plant primary subject and marine/ecology context. The frozen human palace subject does not establish these; no square frame is substituted.

Collection-object capture/treatment continuity requires heritage-documentation context. This is fictional palace life, not an accession/conservation record, and one still does not establish treatment-stage history.

N1_THRESHOLD realizes gaze beyond an actual timber lattice at the visitor; this changes the attention endpoint from the messenger and paper to a threshold view. The final retains direct messenger-directed attention instead of layering both targets.

N6_EDICT explores a sealed court token/document in the foreground. It increases institutional prop weight and would shift the paper from unfastened petition toward a sealed object; the final keeps the visibly unfinished transfer and no extra sealed token.

The complete casting presentation uses adult face/hair, squarely presented face, soft frontal daylight and restrained surface treatment. There is no frozen adult fact, and front-facing casting register would alter the current three-quarter relational portrait. General real skin remains independently authored, not partial candidate adoption.

N5_COUNTERGAZE includes the complete proposed eye-smile geometry: cheek/outer-eye rise, both eyes open with softened apertures and neutral/minimally curved lips. It changes the affect toward reassurance; DIRECT15 keeps gently parted lips and a more undecided pause.

The complete environmental three-quarter portrait already appears in the frozen baseline through reference face/torso/action/room-depth and eye-level medium-wide framing. Retain independent staging; no distinct material-induced addition is needed.

N6_EDICT realizes a foreground court document with face behind. It strengthens institutional hierarchy but foreground enlargement competes with robe-motif and hand-to-tray legibility; DIRECT15 keeps document at the side table. No verified royal decree inferred.

The source is an adult court-attendant subject, not just a service-looking costume. The frozen main woman has no adult-age or attendant-role fact, and the messenger is optional supporting staging rather than permission to replace the main subject. No native role/age adoption.

The full short-light relation needs five connected camera/cheek/key/shadow/readability relations and an adult character prerequisite. No frozen adult fact exists, and the baseline window-light phrase alone does not satisfy all five. Source remains unselected; no lighting-profile gate activated.

The full makeup system requires all eight component groups plus a face-large frame and neutral facial key. Its broad appearance changes cannot safely establish compatibility with protected reference facial appearance, and the requested scene must retain paper, tray and messenger in one view. A generic skin-texture phrase is not adoption; all eight-profile gates stay inactive.
